description.plain:
Business Problem.

Cement plants depend on reliable equipment and timely availability of maintenance spares. Maintenance orders, breakdown notifications, cost postings, equipment attributes, preventive-maintenance plans and material/stock information may sit in separate operational domains. Without a consolidated view, teams can find it difficult to identify the plant or equipment driving downtime, understand maintenance-cost exposure, monitor PM-related breakdown patterns and check whether critical spares are available against reorder parameters.
